flows:
Navigate to https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ then Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in the browser.
Scroll through the report page and count the separate claim cards.
Assert The page shows one card per claim.
Assert The number of claim cards is 8.
Store The number of separate claim cards on the report page, as a digit as 'claim_card_count'.

remark: scroll: Scrolling through the report page to count separate claim cards
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'The number of separate claim cards on the report page,
assert: The page shows one card per claim.
assert: The number of claim cards is 8.

summary:
Opened the README Lie Detector report page and reviewed the claim cards throughout the report.
Confirmed that each claim has its own separate card.
Counted 8 claim cards in total.
one_liner: counted claim cards on the README Lie Detector report page

one_card_per_claim_check.query: whether each claim in the Claims report has exactly one separate claim card
one_card_per_claim_check.condition: The page shows one card per claim.
one_card_per_claim_check.human_description: Checking the claim-to-card correspondence in the report
locators: internal:text="README Lie Detector 38.7 Kane credits this run All 8 claims are true. This"i

claim_card_count_check.query: the number of claim cards reported in the Claims report summary
claim_card_count_check.condition: The number of claim cards is 8.
claim_card_count_check.human_description: Reading the number of claim cards in the report summary

claim_card_count.query: the number of separate claim cards on the report page
claim_card_count.condition: The number of separate claim cards on the report page, as a digit is stored as {{claim_card_count}}.
claim_card_count.human_description: Extracting the number of claim cards from the report summary
